shortDescription: The SENSEX Index dropped 374 points or 0.49 percent on Wednesday to close at 76570 points.Losses were led by Mahindra & Mahindra (-2.09%), Asian Paints (-1.86%) and Infosys (-1.86%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Adani Ports (1.41%), Power Grid (1.23%) and Tata Motors (0.65%).

children: The SENSEX Index dropped 374 points or 0.49 percent on Wednesday to close at 76570 points.

title: The SENSEX Index Closes 0.49% Lower
